## REQ-RES-REFDES-001

**Fields of the ReferenceDesignation DataSet**

The Payload of a ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage contains the optional objects Function, Product and Location (reference designation of the asset according to IEC 81346-1); each object contains the mandatory String Value (designation value), the optional String Local (local designation value) and the optional object Parent, which contains the mandatory String Value, the optional String Local and the optional String IdentificationLink (unencoded Identification Link of the parent asset); no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component supports the resource ReferenceDesignation (REQ-CMP-020).
- Scope: MG 4
- Refs: MG 8.3.10, SF-068
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-8.3.10-02f627f3, MG-8.3.10-1f7e4106, MG-8.3.10-255b94f8, MG-8.3.10-2594d1f8, MG-8.3.10-2684af4b, MG-8.3.10-26a4343a, MG-8.3.10-2d2571c9, MG-8.3.10-362f96db, MG-8.3.10-39f50e4b, MG-8.3.10-3d78517a, MG-8.3.10-3e41890a, MG-8.3.10-86bc7b35, MG-8.3.10-87d2c21a, MG-8.3.10-913074aa, MG-8.3.10-b9996a06, MG-8.3.10-c7d632f5, MG-8.3.10-d84c70c5, MG-8.3.10-dab61376, MG-8.3.10-dc755ab4, MG-8.3.10-e66a9003, MG-8.3.10-f15972dd

Notes: The structure is identical for all three objects (SF-068 (d), GL-ADR-019).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-002

**ReferenceDesignation is persisted**

A component that accepts the ReferenceDesignation from outside persists it (application specific), so that it survives a restart.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set for ReferenceDesignation.
- Refs: MG 8.3.10
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-8.3.10-1b81e498

> Therefore, it must be persisted on an application-specific basis.
> — MG 8.3.10

## REQ-RES-REFDES-003

**Get ReferenceDesignation carries no ReferenceDesignation object**

A Get ReferenceDesignation NetworkMessage contains no ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage; its Messages are empty or contain only the helper DataSets PaginationRequest and Locale.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Scope: MG 8.3.11, MG 8.3.12
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-43119edc

> In combination with the method Get, the payload requires an empty NetworkMessage.
> — MG 9.1.10

> A ReferenceDesignation object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.10

## REQ-RES-REFDES-004

**Get ReferenceDesignation is answered with all addressed objects**

A Get ReferenceDesignation is answered with the ReferenceDesignation of every asset addressed by the topic – without Source all assets of the component, with Source only that asset – each in its own DataSetMessage of a single NetworkMessage published to the corresponding Pub topic.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component supports the resource ReferenceDesignation (REQ-CMP-020).
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-062
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-963a219d, MG-9.1.10-a4676341

> Via the &lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>[/&lt;Source>] combination Get/ReferenceDesignation[/&lt;Source>], the publication of this information to the Pub/ReferenceDesignation[/&lt;Source>] topic can be triggered.
> — MG 9.1.10

> A topic, such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Get/ReferenceDesignation, must trigger a publication of all available ReferenceDesignation information, each in its own DataSetMessage added to a single NetworkMessage and published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/ReferenceDesignation.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Pagination of large answers is REQ-PAG-005, ReplyTo is REQ-MSG-015.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-005

**Pub ReferenceDesignation carries objects and optionally Pagination**

A Pub ReferenceDesignation NetworkMessage contains ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessages and optionally the helper DataSet Pagination; it contains no PaginationRequest and no DataSetMessage of another resource.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-7175ba83

> In combination with the method Pub, the payload contains DataSetMessages of type ReferenceDesignation and optional Pagination (8.3.11.2 Pagination).
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: A Locale is only meaningful in a Get and ignored in other methods (REQ-LOC-002).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-006

**Set ReferenceDesignation addresses exactly one asset**

A Set ReferenceDesignation is sent to Set/ReferenceDesignation/&lt;Source> and its NetworkMessage contains exactly one ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage – the object of the asset addressed by the topic, which replaces its complete ReferenceDesignation (aspects not contained are removed).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, MG 8.3.10, SF-068
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-8.3.10-0bec1aee, MG-9.1.10-90a987bb, MG-9.1.10-c7b9efea, MG-9.1.10-e3d3cf86

> A topic with method Set must contain Resource and Source to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.10

> The ReferenceDesignation object of an asset is always handled as a whole: a Set replaces the complete object, i.e. aspects (Function, Product, Location) which are not contained in the Set are removed, and a Del deletes the complete ReferenceDesignation of the asset (9.1.10 ReferenceDesignation).
> — MG 8.3.10

> Each publication, using the method Set must be done explicitly.
> — MG 9.1.10

> Setting multiple reference designations at once via Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Set/ReferenceDesignation is not possible due to security reasons because it can not be validated via an access control list by the Message Bus.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Whole-object semantics per SF-068 (f), GL-ADR-019; topic form per REQ-TOP-013 (matrix).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-007

**Del ReferenceDesignation addresses exactly one asset**

A Del ReferenceDesignation is sent to Del/ReferenceDesignation/&lt;Source> and its NetworkMessage contains no ReferenceDesignation DataSetMessage; it deletes the complete ReferenceDesignation of the asset identified by the Source.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-068
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-b6c074a3, MG-9.1.10-dfcc5dea, MG-9.1.10-f55cfe37

> In combination with the method Del, a ReferenceDesignation object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.10

> A topic with method Del must contain Resource and Source to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.10

> Each publication, using the method Del must be done explicitly.
> — MG 9.1.10

> Deleting multiple reference designations at once via Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Del/ReferenceDesignation is not possible due to security reasons because it can not be validated via an access control list by the Message Bus.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Whole-object semantics per MG 8.3.10 (REQ-RES-REFDES-006), SF-068 (e), GL-ADR-019.

## REQ-RES-REFDES-008

**Set and Del ReferenceDesignation are protected by ACL**

The operator of the Message Bus prevents Set and Del ReferenceDesignation by unauthorized communication participants via the ACL of the broker.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: broker, platform
- Refs: MG 9.1.10
- Verification: d8
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-0787e338, MG-9.1.10-65150700

> To prevent write access by unauthorized communication participants, the operator must prevent this via ACL.
> — MG 9.1.10

## REQ-RES-REFDES-009

**Status event after Set and Del ReferenceDesignation**

After a Set or Del ReferenceDesignation, the component publishes an Event of the category Status about the command on Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> with the Source of the request topic – mandatory from Level 2 on, recommended at Level 1.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set or Del for ReferenceDesignation.
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-067
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-afc50173, MG-9.1.10-d9b53ba2

> After a Set message arrived, the application must publish an Event message with status information about the Set command to the topic Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> (8.3.6.1 Status) from compliance Level 2 on and should do so at Level 1 (7.4 Method Element) to provide feedback to the caller.
> — MG 9.1.10

> After a Del message arrived, the application must publish an Event message with status information about the Del command to the topic Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> (8.3.6.1 Status) from compliance Level 2 on and should do so at Level 1 (7.4 Method Element) to provide feedback to the caller.
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Same obligation as REQ-TOP-014/015; the last topic level is the EventLevel (SF-067 (g), GL-ADR-019). Event content: RES-EVENT (C-028).

## REQ-RES-REFDES-010

**Changed ReferenceDesignation is published after a successful Set**

After a successful Set ReferenceDesignation, the component publishes the new ReferenceDesignation of the asset to Pub/ReferenceDesignation/&lt;Source> with the ReplyTo of the Set.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set for ReferenceDesignation and the Set was successful.
- Refs: MG 9.1.10, SF-068
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-9.1.10-51f2cf7c

> If setting ReferenceDesignation was successful, the new ReferenceDesignation must be published to the Pub/ReferenceDesignation/&lt;Source> topic, according to the settings in PublicationList (8.3.8 PublicationList).
> — MG 9.1.10

Notes: Topic per SF-068 (b), GL-ADR-019; ReplyTo per REQ-MSG-015.
